name: Pumpwood (yagrumo)
desc: A fast-growing pioneer tree that recolonizes hurricane-damaged ground. Birds and bats eat its fruit and spread the seeds.
about: Cecropia schreberiana is a fast-growing tropical tree in the family Urticaceae. It is known by many different common names, including trumpetwood, pumpwood, guarumo, snakewood tree, and downgolog.
